[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/dist/cli/index.js" ] && node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/loop.js" hook UserPromptSubmit || (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsx src/cli/index.ts hook UserPromptSubmit)
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/dist/cli/index.js" ] && node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/loop.js" hook PreToolUse || (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsx src/cli/index.ts hook PreToolUse)
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/dist/cli/index.js" ] && node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/loop.js" hook PostToolUse || (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsx src/cli/index.ts hook PostToolUse)

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/dist/cli/index.js" ] && node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bin/loop.js" hook PostToolUseFailure || (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install tsx src/cli/index.ts hook PostToolUseFailure)
